mapper.sql: SELECT a.analysis_id, a.image_id, a.patient_id, a.lesion_count, a.infection_rate, a.total_infection_area, a.detect_diagnosis, a.ai_result_path, a.detect_result_json, a.diagnosis_report_raw, a.diagnosis_report_json, a.report_create_time, a.is_deleted, a.create_by, a.create_time, p.patient_name, x.image_name FROM ai_image_analysis_result a LEFT JOIN medical_patient p ON p.patient_id = a.patient_id LEFT JOIN chest_xray x ON x.id = a.image_id

SELECT a.analysis_id, a.image_id, a.patient_id, a.lesion_count, a.infection_rate, a.total_infection_area, a.detect_diagnosis, a.ai_result_path, a.report_create_time, a.is_deleted, a.create_by, a.create_time, p.patient_name, x.image_name FROM ai_image_analysis_result a LEFT JOIN medical_patient p ON p.patient_id = a.patient_id LEFT JOIN chest_xray x ON x.id = a.image_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_image_analysis_result ( image_id, patient_id, lesion_count, infection_rate, total_infection_area, detect_diagnosis, ai_result_path, detect_result_json, diagnosis_report_raw, diagnosis_report_json, report_create_time, create_by, create_time, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{imageId}, #{patientId}, #{lesionCount}, #{infectionRate}, #{totalInfectionArea}, #{detectDiagnosis}, #{aiResultPath}, #{detectResultJson}, #{diagnosisReportRaw}, #{diagnosisReportJson}, #{reportCreateTime}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, 0 )
